## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `1913510660385507697739bade8ad2786634d9d9`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md, docs/NORTH-STAR.md + none

Inputs read: card #33163 (body and both comments: the claim and the os-dev-report), PR #33279 (body, file list, net diff, +3/-3 over 2 files), and the check-runs on this head. The merge base is `d4fbb4db`; `main` has moved one commit past it (#33218) and that commit touches neither file, so the net diff against `main` is the PR diff as shown.

### ① Derived judgments

- No accept set and no public surface moves: the diff is three prose lines in two governed files, published by no package. Right.
- The one behaviour that changes is what a seat reads: rule 3's hold no longer covers a p2 `pm:blocking` card that an open P0/P1 of the lane names on its `Blocked-by:` line. This widens what a lane may dispatch, in exactly the direction the ruling relayed on the card asks for (item 2). Right.
- No script implements the hold. Read on `main`: the `tooling` label's consumers in `scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh` key on an `Unblocks:` line or a named published surface, never on the lane's open P0/P1, and nothing else under `scripts/pm/**` reads rule 3. No code or self-test is owed. Right.
- Governed landing: both paths are on the register (`.claude/**`, `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`), Tier H. `Governed Surface Queue Guard` is green on the head. Right.
- Skill line ratchet: `execution-duties.md` stays at 190 lines; the edited line is 115 bytes, under the 120-byte cap. `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` and `Lint · repo & tooling gates` are green. Right.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is on the PR and is correct: `docs/**` and `.claude/**` only, nothing a package publishes. `Check Changeset` is green on the head.

Clause-②: no — matches the claim on the card and the PR body; the diff declares no narrowing and changes no published schema.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: empty. Nothing to answer.
- Deviation 1 (visible signature line instead of an HTML-comment trailer on the PR body): accepted; `PR-body guards` is green on the head.
- Deviation 2 (line 50 drops 「队列」 to fit the byte cap): accepted, with the nit in ④ (c).
- Deviation 3 (model-free commit trailer): a commit-message matter outside the reviewed faces; no contract effect.
- Out-of-scope note (#32997 question 3, rule 3 against the `reach:` admission p3): correctly left untouched; the card puts it out of scope until the maintainer rules.
- The card carries no eval prompt, so the skill file is judged against the card's Do and Acceptance and against the text it points at.

### ④ Design judgment

**`docs/NORTH-STAR.md`, the road (line 11).** Holds. The stale "is P2" becomes a pointer, `graded by "Priority" rule 2`, and rule 2 on this head does grade a wrong run (data silently wrong or lost is P1 subject to the reach discount, any other run that goes wrong is P2). The quoted-section pointer follows the file's own convention (`Grading reads "Features on the road"`). The card's Do 1 asks that the road agree with rule 2; a pointer agrees and cannot drift again. No finding.

**`docs/NORTH-STAR.md`, Priority rule 3 (line 116).** The exemption is stated once and matches the ruling's letter. It keys on the `Blocked-by:` line, the same reverse index `pm:blocking` is derived from, so it needs no new label or state. It also reaches the real case: a blocked P0/P1 is undispatched, hence "open" under `execution-duties.md` line 51, hence it was holding its own unblocker. Two findings:

- (a) **should-fix — a second reader of the hold condition was missed and can undo the exemption.** `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md` line 63 on `main` reads the same condition in the same words (「所入车道队列 P0/P1 开着(= 未派发,在飞不算)时,三门皆无的 p2/p3 `tooling` 卡同样关」) and closes the card at first touch. The three doors (lines 39 to 40) key on the blocker's OWN first line (`Unblocks: #N`), on a named published surface, or on measured fleet drag. The new exemption keys on the DEPENDENT's `Blocked-by:` line. A p2 tooling card that an open P0/P1 names on `Blocked-by:` but that carries no `Unblocks:` line of its own is therefore exempt from the hold under rule 3 and closed not_planned by triage under line 63: the P0/P1 still waits on its unblocker, which is the outcome the ruling removes. The card's Do 3 asks for every reader of the hold in the dispatch references to carry the exemption by pointer; the PR's sweep names `triage-duties.md` line 60 only and so reports `execution-duties.md` line 50 as the sole reader. Fix: either one pointer on `triage-duties.md` line 63 (a card an open P0/P1 names on `Blocked-by:` is not closed there), or a ruled statement that being named on that line counts as door one. This file is outside the diff and was read, not reviewed; the finding is against the completeness of the change on the `hits` files. If the seat prefers, it lands as a follow-up card rather than on this head, since rule 3 itself is correct as written.
- (b) **nit — the exemption is direct and same-lane only.** "a p2 `pm:blocking` card that such a P0/P1 names" covers a card the lane's own open P0/P1 names directly. A second-level blocker (it blocks the exempt card, not the P0/P1) stays held, and so does a tooling card in one lane that unblocks a P0/P1 in another lane while its own lane has an unrelated open P0/P1. Both follow the ruling's wording (「替它解锁的」) and the PR body states the first on purpose, so this is an accepted reading, not a defect; worth one line to the maintainer if either case shows up in a queue.

**`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md` (line 50).** Holds. 「第 3 条(含豁免)」 is a pointer, not a copy, so the exemption stays stated once, as the Acceptance requires. Line 51 still defines 开放 as undispatched, and the take-order on lines 52 to 53 already ranks `pm:blocking` above p1, so an exempt card is picked in order with no further change. `dispatch-runbook.md` (the other file the card names) restates no part of the hold and needs no pointer.

- (c) **nit — 「本车道队列开放 P0/P1」 became 「本车道开放 P0/P1」.** The north star still says "a lane's queue" and `triage-duties.md` line 63 still says 「车道队列」. The reading does not change (line 51 defines the term), so no effect on the contract; the wording now differs between the two references.

No must-fix. One should-fix (a), which earns a delta review of its fix or a follow-up card; two nits (b), (c).

Check-runs on this head: every run is completed; none failed, none pending. The skipped runs are path-filtered or opt-in jobs.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `8850480e0f299fbe52bb966147cf20ba2af6f85b`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md, docs/NORTH-STAR.md + none

Delta review of rework round 1. Inputs read: card #33163 (body and all three comments, the round-1 os-dev-report included), PR #33279 (file list, the delta `19135106..8850480e`, and the net diff against `main` on this head: +4/-4 over 3 files), and the check-runs on this head. The PR body still describes round 0; the tree is judged, not the body. The merge base is still `d4fbb4db`; `main` has moved past it and none of those commits touches the three files, so the net diff is the PR diff as shown.

### ① Derived judgments

- Still no accept set and no public surface: four prose lines in three governed files, published by no package. Right.
- The delta is two lines. `triage-duties.md` line 63 gains the exemption pointer; `execution-duties.md` line 50 takes 「队列」 back. `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` is byte-identical to the head reviewed in round 0. Right.
- What a seat now reads differently: triage no longer closes, at first touch, a door-less p2 `tooling` card that an undispatched P0/P1 of the lane names on its `Blocked-by:` line. This is the same direction as rule 3's exemption and the ruling relayed on the card. Right.
- No script implements the hold or the triage close (read on `main` in round 0, unchanged). No code or self-test is owed. Right.
- Governed landing: all three paths are on the register, Tier H. `Governed Surface Queue Guard` is green on this head. Right.
- Skill line ratchet: `triage-duties.md` line 63 is 120 bytes and `execution-duties.md` line 50 is 118, both within the 120-byte cap; neither file's line count moves. `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` and `Lint · repo & tooling gates` are green on this head. Right.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is on the PR and is correct: `docs/**` and `.claude/**` only, nothing a package publishes. `Check Changeset` is skipped on this head under the label.

Clause-②: no — unchanged from round 0 and still right; the delta declares no narrowing and touches no published schema.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: empty in the round-1 report. Nothing to answer.
- Round-1 deviation (the dev handed the round-1 PR body to the seat as a file instead of patching it): accepted; a body matter, outside the reviewed faces. The seat owes the body rewrite before the maintainer reads it, since the body on the PR still says `execution-duties.md` line 50 is the only reader and that 「队列」 was dropped.
- Round-0 deviations stand as accepted in the round-0 record.
- Out-of-scope note (#32997 question 3): still untouched, correctly.

### ④ Design judgment

**`docs/NORTH-STAR.md`.** Unchanged in the delta. The round-0 judgment stands: the road's pointer to "Priority" rule 2 agrees with rule 2, and rule 3 states the exemption once in the ruling's own terms.

**`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md` (line 63).** Round-0 finding (a), should-fix: **fixed.** The line now ends 「「Priority」第 3 条豁免除外」. It is a pointer, not a copy, so the exemption is still stated once (the card's Acceptance), and the section name resolves through line 60 of the same file (北极星「Priority」). The condition lost its inline gloss, 「开着(= 未派发,在飞不算)」 became 「未派」; the meaning is the same, an in-flight P0/P1 is dispatched and so does not count, and `execution-duties.md` line 51 still carries the full definition. No new finding on this line.

**`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md` (line 50).** Round-0 nit (c): **fixed.** 「本车道队列开放 P0/P1」 is back, in step with the north star's "a lane's queue" and with `triage-duties.md` line 63. 「每次取卡现读」 became 「取卡时现读」 to pay for it; the rule is still read live at the pick, and line 57 (「全序每级现读/现算」) keeps the every-time reading. No finding.

Carried and new, neither blocking:

- (b) **nit, carried from round 0 — the exemption is direct and same-lane only.** Unchanged by the delta; it follows the ruling's wording and stays an accepted reading.
- (d) **nit, new — an exempt card with no door is spared the close but still cannot be picked.** Admission of a `tooling` card is a separate, unconditional rule: `triage-duties.md` line 39 (enters `pm:queue` only through one of the three doors) and `execution-duties.md` line 8 (the candidate set excludes a door-less `tooling` card), neither touched here. Line 8 sits in a `hits` file and was not named in round 0. So a blocker named on a P0/P1's `Blocked-by:` line that carries no `Unblocks:` line of its own is now kept open instead of closed, and becomes dispatchable once that line is written on it. That is consistent: the ruling lifts the P0/P1 hold, not the tooling doors, and after this delta the doors are the only thing left between such a card and dispatch. It is recorded so that the next reader does not take line 63's pointer for an admission. A one-line follow-up (being named on an open P0/P1's `Blocked-by:` counts as door one) is the maintainer's call, not owed by this PR.

No must-fix and no should-fix on this head. Nits alone: the round ends.

Check-runs on this head: all 48 are completed; none failed, none pending. Every run is success or skipped (the skipped ones are path-filtered, label-skipped or opt-in jobs).
